;Armed conflicts and attacks

**The [[United States]]' allies [[France]] and the [[United Kingdom]] say they won't keep their troops in [[Syria]] after the United States pulls out. *[[Libyan Crisis (2011–present)]]
**The [[Tobruk]]-based [[Libyan National Army]] says it has taken control of the [[Elephant Field|El Feel oilfield]] in [[Libya]]'s southern [[Murzuq District]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-libya-oil/eastern-libyan-military-forces-claim-control-of-el-feel-oilfield-idUSKCN1QA2AX (Reuters)]

;International relations
*[[Russia–United States relations]]
**[[President of Russia|Russian President]] [[Vladimir Putin]] states that Russia is militarily ready for "a [[Cuban Missile Crisis|Cuban Missile]]-style crisis" if the [[United States]] wants one, in relation to new U.S. missile deployments in [[Europe]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-russia-putin/putin-to-u-s-im-ready-for-another-cuban-missile-crisis-if-you-want-one-idUSKCN1QA1A3 (Reuters)]
*[[2019 North Korea–United States Hanoi Summit]]
**[[Vietnam]] tightens security at its [[rail station]] on the [[China–Vietnam border|Chinese border]] ahead of [[List of leaders of North Korea|North Korean leader]] [[Kim Jong-un]]'s visit to [[Hanoi]] for his summit with [[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-northkorea-usa-vietnam-border/vietnam-tightens-security-at-border-station-ahead-of-kim-jong-un-visit-idUSKCN1QA1EI (Reuters)]
*[[2019 Venezuelan presidential crisis]], [[2019 shipping of humanitarian aid to Venezuela]]
**[[President of Venezuela|Venezuelan President]] [[Nicolás Maduro]] orders the closing of [[Brazil–Venezuela border|his country's border with Brazil]]. International [[humanitarian aid]] is currently scheduled to enter Venezuela on February 23, under foreign military protection. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-latin-america-47325201 (BBC News)]

;Law and crime
*American actor [[Jussie Smollett]] is arrested for filing a false police report about an alleged [[hate crime]]. [https://www.foxnews.com/entertainment/jussie-smollett-is-under-arrest-in-custody-of-chicago-police (Fox News)]
*[[Hoda Muthana]], an [[Alabama]] woman who joined the [[Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant|Islamic State]], is banned from entering the [[United States]]. [https://amp.usatoday.com/amp/2914244002 (''USA Today'')] [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/amp/world-us-canada-47313657 (BBC News)]

;Politics and elections
*[[2017–18 Spanish constitutional crisis|Spanish constitutional crisis]]
**[[Catalonian separatism|Separatists]] in [[Catalonia]] launch a [[general strike]] in protest of the [[trial of Catalonia independence leaders]], with major participation of the educational community. Demonstrators block major roads, highways, train tracks and the entrance to the port of [[Tarragona]]. [http://time.com/5534324/catalan-secessionists-block-highways-strike/ (''Time'')] [https://abcnews.go.com/Politics/wireStory/catalan-secessionists-block-highways-train-tracks-strike-61205982 (''ABC News'')] [https://www.cope.es/actualidad/economia/noticias/cerca-200-manifestantes-cortan-entrada-del-puerto-tarragona-20190221_357990 (Cope)]
**Clashes between demonstrators and [[Mossos d'Esquadra|Catalan regional police]] leave three arrested and 20 injured. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/business/catalan-secessionists-block-highways-train-tracks-in-strike/2019/02/21/dbe49b52-35ae-11e9-8375-e3dcf6b68558_story.html (''The Washington Post'')]
*[[2018 North Carolina's 9th congressional district election]]
** [[North Carolina]] election authorities unanimously order a new election to choose the district's representative to the [[United States House of Representatives]] after their investigation determined the Republican candidate's campaign illegally handled absentee ballots, and the candidate, [[Mark Harris (North Carolina politician)|Mark Harris]], reverses his position and calls for a new election. [https://www.nytimes.com/2019/02/21/us/mark-harris-nc-voter-fraud.html  (''The New York Times'')] [https://www.npr.org/2019/02/21/696561080/email-shows-n-c-gop-candidate-sought-out-operative-accused-of-illegal-ballot-sch  (NPR)]
*[[2019 Venezuelan presidential crisis]]
**[[United Socialist Party of Venezuela]] congressman and former head of the [[Dirección General de Contrainteligencia Militar |Directorate General of Military Counterintelligence]] [[Hugo Carvajal]] defects to the opposition, urging the military to abandon [[Nicolás Maduro]]. Carvajal says [[drug trafficking]] and corruption are commonplace in the government. [https://www.nytimes.com/2019/02/21/world/americas/hugo-carvajal-maduro-venezuela.html (''The New York Times'')]
*[[April 2019 Israeli legislative election|2019 Israeli legislative election]]
**Retired [[Chief of the General Staff (Israel)|IDF Chief]] [[Benny Gantz]] and [[Yesh Atid]] chairman [[Yair Lapid]] agree to combine their [[Prime Minister of Israel|prime minister]]ial campaigns in the April 9 [[Knesset]] election against incumbent  [[Benjamin Netanyahu]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-47316511 (BBC News)]

;Science and technology
*A fossil from a new species of ''[[Tyrannosauroidea|tyrannosaur]]'' named ''[[Moros intrepidus]]'' is discovered in the U.S. state of [[Utah]]. Scientists are using the find to better understand how ''[[Tyrannosaurus|Tyrannosaurus rex]]'' evolved during the [[Cretaceous|Cretaceous period]]. [https://www.nationalgeographic.com/science/2019/02/new-tiny-t-rex-relative-moros-fills-north-american-fossil-gap/ (''National Geographic'')]
*Scientists announce that the ''[[Megachile pluto]]'' (Wallace's giant bee), the world's largest [[bee]], has been rediscovered in [[North Maluku]], [[Indonesia]], after no confirmed sightings since 1981. The first ever pictures and videos are taken of the rare species. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/science-environment-47311186 (BBC News)]
*[[JAXA]]'s ''[[Hayabusa2]]'' space probe successfully lands on [[Apollo asteroid]] [[162173 Ryugu]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/science/2019/feb/22/japans-hayabusa-2-successfully-touches-down-on-ryugu-asteroid (''The Guardian'')]
